_comment: Endpoints whose request/response PAYLOADS are omitted from API logging. The call itself is
still logged everywhere (method, URL, status, duration) — only the bodies are replaced with
a short note. Intended for high-volume reference-data reads whose payloads are pure noise.
This file is the SINGLE source of truth for both sides. The client applies it to the
ApiLogSidebar and its own console logging, and sends X-Suppress-Payload-Log on the outgoing
request so CyberSourceServer suppresses its console payload logging for the same call.
Suppression NEVER applies to a failed call: any non-2xx status, transport exception, or 2XX
response carrying an ErrorObject logs the full payload regardless of what is configured here,
because that is exactly when the payload is needed.
path     - request path to match, e.g. "/api/samplecards". Case-insensitive; a trailing
slash is ignored, so "/api/samplecards" also matches "/api/samplecards/".
method   - HTTP method to match, or "*"/omitted for any.
match    - "prefix" (default) or "exact". Prefix also covers sub-routes, so
note     - text shown in place of the payload. Defaults to "success".
Any endpoint can be added here. Removing an entry restores full payload logging with no
code change; an absent or malformed file simply means nothing is suppressed.
